import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Gender')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts()
top_occupations = occupation_counts.head(5).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.scatterplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='Occupation', size='Physical Activity Level', sizes=(30, 200), 
                alpha=0.7, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 3. Physical Activity Level by Age Group
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65], 
                         labels=['15-25', '26-35', '36-45', '46-55', '56-65'])
activity_by_age = df.groupby(['Age Group', 'Gender'])['Physical Activity Level'].mean().unstack()
activity_by_age.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
ax3.set_title('Average Physical Activity Level by Age Group and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(title='Gender')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
sleep_disorder_order = ['None', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Insomnia']
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Daily Steps', 
               order=sleep_disorder_order, ax=ax4, palette='Set2')
ax4.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)

# 5. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Blood Pressure Categories Distribution
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
# Extract systolic pressure (first part of blood pressure)
df['Systolic'] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/').str[0].astype(int)
df['BP Category'] = pd.cut(df['Systolic'], 
                          bins=[0, 120, 130, 140, 200],
                          labels=['Normal', 'Elevated', 'High Stage 1', 'High Stage 2'])
bp_counts = df['BP Category'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Blues(np.linspace(0.4, 0.9, len(bp_counts)))
bp_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=colors)
ax6.set_title('Blood Pressure Categories Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Blood Pressure Category', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
